fullPassage: In the Old Stone Age, small bands of 20 to 60 people wandered from place to place in search of food. Once people began farming, they could settle down near their farms. As a result, towns and villages grew larger. Living in communities allowed people to organize themselves more efficiently. They could divide up the work of producing food and other things they needed. While some workers grew crops, others built new houses and made tools. Village dwellers also learned to work together to do a task faster. For example, toolmakers could share the work of making stone axes and knives. By working together, they could make more tools in the same amount of time.

공동체 생활은 사람들이 스스로를 조직하게 해주었다.

[조건] (1) allowed, communities, in, living, organize, people, themselves, to를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: living in communities allowed people to organize themselves
det.analysis:
본문: 'Living in communities allowed people to organize themselves more efficiently' — 동명사 주어(Living) + allow O to V.

[조건 검증] living(1) in(2) communities(3) allowed(4) people(5) to(6) organize(7) themselves(8) = 8단어 ✅
det.tip: allow A to V = A가 ~하게 하다
